name: Outunmoor
description: Cloaked in perpetual twilight, the Outunmoor Swamp stretches across the northern Freelands, its expanse veiled in spectral fog. This marsh is home to a unique ecosystem, attracting scholars and healers with its rare herbs—both valuable and perilous to gather. Yet its true allure lies in the hidden Lakilato Ruins, where the ancient Ruins of Kölm stand as the remains of a once mighty Kemet kingdom that was abandoned ages ago. Many adventurers have sought to explore the ruins; some return bearing powerful magic items, while others vanish without a trace. Recent rumors suggest that an ancient curse has reawakened near Lakilato, leading to the mysterious disappearance of numerous explorers. This curse is believed to transform intruders into swamp monstrosities. However, the swamp is indeed fraught with danger. Numerous lizardfolk tribes inhabit the regions far from the Lakilato Ruins, and within the ruins themselves, Penumbral Rifts are concealed in sunken structures, allowing aberrations to emerge from the Penumbral Plane. On moonless nights, the ancient Kemet magic that lingers in the ruins stirs, reanimating the deceased as undead for a single night. One specific locus of power, known only to Avelum and Rigilia in the Republic, as well as Grace Sung in the Magocracy, is the Stone Circles in the northern part of Lakilato. Here, ancient magic enables portals to other planes of existence to open, provided the runed stones are correctly aligned during specific celestial events. Occasionally, extraplanar beings breach into Tanares through this nexus; some cross willingly, while others are transported without understanding their new whereabouts.
